biotools.summary: ROCker models are used for the reliable detection and typing of short-read sequences carrying antibiotic resistance genes such as *mcr*, *erm*, *mph*, and *lnu*. The models are freely available and facilitate more accurate classification and quantification of unassembled short-read sequences for these ARG families.
